# R59: Tailoring-first customer experience — approved staging design directive
Date: 22 November 2026
Status: OWNER APPROVED FOR STAGING IMPLEMENTATION ONLY
Scope: homepage; /services/custom-tailoring/; central /collections/ Showroom; Shop inspiration and backorder display; approved fallback photo galleries; staging QA. No new production publication permission.

## Owner objective and exact public wording
Brand: Mr Sewing Fashion. First-screen headline: "Professional Tailor in Kigali, Rwanda". Lead service page label: "Tailoring & Clothing Services" with URL preserved /services/custom-tailoring/. This supersedes the older "Custom Tailoring & Suits" public headline for the hub and its navigation label, **not** the underlying custom-tailoring enquiry/service identification and associated commercial rules.

## Owner-approved journey
- Homepage: short tailoring-first hero, existing consented WhatsApp design handoff, /collections/ Showroom, tailoring hub, two neutral photo cards as **held-video fallbacks**, visually prominent tailoring/VIP cards, approved feature photo, two opposite-direction eligible gallery rows, existing support/contact. Shop is subordinate.
- Hub logical order: general order/fabric/measurements/fittings/quotations/confirmation/terms; exactly two data-driven cards to Showroom gender men/women; four distinct extra services Special Tailoring, Alterations & Repairs, Garment Care & Cleaning and Mobile Tailoring & Fittings. VIP stays separate.
- Showroom: All at /collections/, category navigation using the same authoritative _data/clothing-category-config.json and published design loader. Future categories remain withheld unless eligible photographs and approved classification exist. Keep image families grouped.
- Dates: use real date of addition/upload/publication with an auditable provenance and the date's actual meaning. Existing approved legacy photographs lack precise dated metadata; preserve old deterministic order instead of inventing a chronology. Keep true ties stable.
- Shop: three public status values Available in Stock, Available on Backorder, Out of Stock, with all existing stock/price/rights checks unchanged and no automatic promotion. Tailoring inspiration is separate from real merchandise and Shop enquiries.
- Terms: existing 5-page approved PDF reader at /terms-and-conditions/, currently effective HTML fallback /terms-and-conditions/current/. Approved content is not silently activated; standalone-payment and contractual-surcharge reconciliations remain open.

## Media gates and remaining owner decisions
- R53 25 photographs (22 separate held records, including image 12 visually Burgundy and MS-169's grouped three views) remain rights-held and NOT displayed as new public references. No authorship or original garment manufacturing dates invented.
- Two R53 suit videos 1024X768VIDEO.mp4 and 1024X768black.mp4 are correctly men’s fashion reference videos. The owners of video/third-party imagery/creator rights, descriptive metadata and exact posters are not yet verified. Prepare no-audio temporary derivatives for private review, and retain approved still photographs on the publicly reachable staging domain.
- The Shop’s enquiry-only records and unverified merchandise values remain separate from approved sale-published products; no stock or completion promises.
- No customer submission, paid campaign, privacy change or live production publication is authorised.
